'''Quantum particle interaction''' is the interaction between two or more [[quantum particle]]s.

== Conservation ==

The following properties are conserved:

* Before and after '''any''' quantum particle interaction
** $\sum \mathrm{B}$, the total [[baryon number]],
** $\sum L_e,\sum L_\mu, \sum L_\tau$, the total [[lepton numbers]],

* If the interaction does '''not''' involve the [[weak force]]
** $\sum \mathrm{S}$, the total [[strangeness]]
